description: Pay Stay parking restrictions is a dataset listed in City of Melbourne Open Data Portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by data.melbourne.vic.gov.au. This dataset refers to a deprecated parking management solution. It contains detailed historical information on parking restrictions in each Pay Stay zone. There can be multiple restrictions per Pay Stay zone per day. This data can be linked to both the street segment Pay Stay zone dataset. Coverage: City of Melbourne. The portal files it under Transport. Its keywords are parking, paystay, restrictions, signs, travel. The portal shows 6,270 records. The portal shows 2026-09-03 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/legalcode). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-melbourne-vic-gov-au-portal.
